about.title: Perris Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A product is supposed to do what the box says. When a space heater in a Perris apartment shorts out, a ladder buckles in a backyard off 4th Street, or a tire fails on the Ramona Expressway, the fallout lands on the person who trusted it. Riverside County households rely on thousands of products every day, and when one of them fails, the aftermath rarely feels simple. California law gives injured people a real advantage here. Product liability claims often proceed under strict liability, which means you generally have to show the product was defective — in its design, in how it was manufactured, or in the warnings that came with it — and that the defect caused your injury. Proving the company was careless is usually not required. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect Perris residents with an independent personal injury attorney who handles product cases. That attorney works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Perris Residents Use LawProactive for Product Claims

items.title: Strict Liability Works in Your Favor
items.desc: In California you generally don't have to prove a manufacturer was negligent — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. An attorney in our network can explain which type of defect fits your situation.

items.title: More Than One Company May Owe You
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and the Perris retailer who sold the item can all share responsibility under California law. Identifying every party in the supply chain is part of building the claim.

items.title: Free Connection, Contingency Representation
items.desc: LawProactive charges nothing to connect you with an independent attorney. That attorney works on contingency, so you pay no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My airbag didn't deploy in a collision on Perris Boulevard. Is that a product liability case or a car accident case?
items.answer: It can be both. Perris recorded 267 injury collisions in 2025, and in some of them the harm was made worse by a vehicle component that failed to work as designed. A defective airbag, seatbelt, or tire may support a separate strict liability claim against the maker, alongside any claim against another driver. An attorney can review the crash details and the part itself to sort out which claims apply.

items.question: Should I throw away the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Please don't. The product is the central piece of evidence in a defect claim, and once it's gone, showing how it failed becomes much harder. Keep it unrepaired, along with the packaging, receipt, and any instructions, and store it somewhere safe until an attorney can examine it.

items.question: I bought the item at a store in Perris, not directly from the manufacturer. Can I still bring a claim?
items.answer: Yes. California product liability law can reach the manufacturer, the distributor, and the retailer that sold you the product, even if the store did nothing wrong itself. This matters when the maker is overseas or hard to locate. Your attorney will determine which parties belong in the claim.
